definitions.explanation: A state of being completely worn out in body and mind. A formal, written-style word that almost always appears in the set phrase {疲労困憊|ひろうこんぱい} ('worn out with fatigue').

examples.japanese: {疲労|ひろう}{困憊|こんぱい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{動|うご}けない→動く：00904_ugoku⟧。
⟦{連日|れんじつ}→連日：14328_renjitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{困憊|こんぱい}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I'm worn out from working overtime day after day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{看病|かんびょう}→看病：16956_kanbyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{心身|しんしん}→心身：04206_shinshin⟧とも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{困憊|こんぱい}⟦していた→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: From the long hours of nursing care, the family was exhausted in both body and mind.

notes:
A formal, written-style noun meaning utter exhaustion. In practice it rarely stands alone — it nearly always appears in the four-character phrase ⟦{疲労困憊|ひろうこんぱい}→疲労困憊：13618_hiroukonpai⟧. Also used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ ({困憊|こんぱい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {疲労|ひろう}{困憊|こんぱい}: worn out with fatigue
- ⟦{心身|しんしん}→心身：04206_shinshin⟧とも⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{困憊|こんぱい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be exhausted in body and mind
- {困憊|こんぱい}しきる: to be completely worn out

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{疲労|ひろう}→疲労：13603_hirou⟧: fatigue; tiredness — everyday word; {困憊|こんぱい} is stronger and more literary
- ⟦へとへと→へとへと：05273_hetoheto⟧: worn out; dead tired — colloquial and vivid, used in casual speech
